segments.text: The first family is Claire and Phil Dunphy and their three children, Haley, Alex, and Luke. Claire is the stricter parent, while Phil likes to think he’s a “cool dad.” Their fifteen-year-old daughter Haley invites a senior named Dylan over, and Claire immediately starts worrying.

segments.text: The third family is Mitchell and his partner Cameron. They’ve just adopted a baby girl named Lily from Vietnam. Mitchell is happy, but he’s nervous about telling his family because he expects his father to judge him.

segments.text: At dinner, the three stories finally come together. Jay is Claire and Mitchell’s father, which means all three households are part of the same family. When Mitchell tells everyone about the adoption, Jay reacts badly and says two men shouldn’t raise a child without a mother.

segments.text: Then Cameron enters, holding Lily in the air while “Circle of Life” plays. The dramatic entrance is funny, but it also changes the mood. Once Jay sees Lily, he softens. He admits that he’s still making mistakes as a father himself and welcomes her into the family.
